title: OpenAI teases Astra, its next major AI model, after it solves 10 long-standing math problems
summary: OpenAI has revealed Astra, an unreleased model designed to tackle complex, long-running tasks, after an internal version produced ten significant advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science. OpenAI also says it's advancing rapidly in science.
